usedFor: Shopify holds the customers, and Chatbase receives each one through “Create Contact” after “New Customer”.

bestTemplate.name: “New Customer” in Shopify, then “Create Contact” in Chatbase
bestTemplate.why: A new customer is the moment to add them as a contact on the chatbot side.

watchOut: “New Customer” is the only trigger paired with “Create Contact”, so other store events cannot add contacts.
